supportWindow.removalGate: Remove only after Portal and every registered consumer report zero Product-root and Product-deep use for the moved exports, with a breaking release note and owner approval.
supportWindow.rollback: During 0.1.x, restore consumers to the Product compatibility root or deep path without changing component behavior; after removal, roll back to the last immutable 0.1.x package set.

decisions.reason: Native anchor navigation, external-link disclosure and accessible naming are generic DOM contracts with no Product workflow semantics.
evidence: Portal candidate 50c2d9b306145805455885201ababf91c8ee6339 already installs Core and Product and uses link navigation across shared UI.
components/buttons/Link.jsx and components/buttons/Link.d.ts expose no application route or domain state contract.

decisions.reason: Anchored disclosure positioning, light dismiss, focus return and panel chrome are generic overlay mechanics already built on Core-owned anchored-overlay.
evidence: Portal candidate 50c2d9b306145805455885201ababf91c8ee6339 uses Popover in src/components/chat/ChatComposerMenus.tsx and src/components/chat/FloatingChat.tsx.
components/overlay/Popover.jsx composes components/overlay/anchored-overlay.js, which is already Core-owned.

decisions.reason: Single-date navigation, parsing, disabled-date state and accessible grid interaction are reusable input contracts independent of a Product workflow.
evidence: Portal candidate 50c2d9b306145805455885201ababf91c8ee6339 uses DatePicker in src/components/research/ResearchProfileWorkspace.tsx.
DateRangeField remains a separate Product composition because it owns coupled start/end validation and range workflow anatomy.

decisions.reason: Native numeric bounds and password reveal semantics extend Core form primitives without introducing application, operations or workspace domain truth.
evidence: components/forms/NumberField.jsx and components/forms/PasswordInput.jsx depend only on reusable input, icon and field behavior.
Their Storybook contracts describe generic form entry, validation and accessibility rather than a Product route or workflow.

decisions.reason: Progressbar and meter roles, determinate state, accessible values and generic status tones are reusable semantic primitives.
evidence: Portal candidate 50c2d9b306145805455885201ababf91c8ee6339 uses CircularProgress through src/components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx.
components/status/ProgressBar.jsx, CircularProgress.jsx and Meter.jsx contain no telemetry transport or job lifecycle truth.

decisions.reason: Coupled start/end entry, ordering validation and range-level error presentation form a Product composition over Core date primitives.
evidence: components/forms/DateRangeField.jsx composes two date inputs and owns cross-field range behavior.
stories/FormDateRange.stories.jsx documents range-level product scenarios independently from DatePicker.

decisions.reason: Renderer-neutral operational presentation is reusable across equipment types but is a richer Product composition than a Core DOM primitive.
evidence: docs/references/architecture/OWNER_AUTHORITY_CONTRACT.json#domainDecisions keeps telemetry truth, thresholds and robot semantics outside Product presentation.
The Product operations family supplies reusable equipment and telemetry anatomy without owning runtime state machines.

decisions.reason: Viewport frames and renderer-neutral controls are Operations-family compositions while spatial navigation and robot safety meaning remain external.
evidence: Web Viz candidate 4dad154883cd452072734587790509b1f857e75f uses Scene3DFrame and ViewerToolbar in frontend/src/components/3d/PointCloudViewer.tsx.
docs/references/architecture/OWNER_AUTHORITY_CONTRACT.json#domainDecisions excludes navigation graph meaning, pose, planning and transport.

decisions.reason: Authority, dead-man behavior, safety release, robot state and navigation coordinates require the independent Robotics owner and release surface.
evidence: lk-design-system-robotics@ab5446b1db76777deb94ec75308a4133cc49d2b1 owns RobotStatusCard, Joystick and navigation transforms.
Web Viz candidate 4dad154883cd452072734587790509b1f857e75f consumes Robotics controls separately from Product viewer chrome.

decisions.reason: These surfaces remain valid Product compositions today, but their generic mechanics may justify Core ownership when independent consumer demand appears.
evidence: No second registered consumer currently demonstrates an owner or bundle boundary that requires moving these four components before stable.
Their current Product stories and package projections remain internally consistent.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Re-open when two registered consumers import a subject directly, or when a Core component requires it without a Product dependency.

decisions.reason: Families improve discovery but current consumers do not show independent bundle, owner or release requirements for public family subpaths.
evidence: Portal and Web Viz candidate imports use package roots and component deep paths rather than family subpaths.
docs/references/architecture/PRODUCT_FAMILY_CONTRACT.json explicitly keeps family taxonomy inside one Product package.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Re-open when at least two consumers request the same family subpath or bundle analysis shows a material independent-loading benefit.

decisions.reason: Narrowing the existing wildcard export would be a package-wide breaking change unrelated to assigning the helper's correct owner.
evidence: Both Core and Product currently expose ./components/* through package export maps.
anchored-panel-style receives a deprecated Product deep compatibility projection for the complete 0.1.x window.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Replace wildcard exports only in a breaking release after a registry-wide private deep-import scan and explicit allowlist design.
